title: State and Output Agreement for Short Runs
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic finite-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer. If a configuration $a$ is ready at $m$ and a Boolean choice word $u$ has length at most $m$, then running $A$ on $u$ from $a$ and running it on $u$ from its initial configuration on $x$ yield configurations with the same state and the same output word.
hypotheses_covered: The choice word $u$ has length at most $m$
